titolo: Printable Ocean Coloring Pages for Kids, 24 Page PDF Coloring Book, Instant Download, Whale Octopus Sea Turtle, Ages 4-8
descrizione:
Dive in! An under the sea printable coloring book with 24 big, simple pages: a happy whale, a sea turtle over the coral, a smiling octopus, a clownfish in its anemone, a seahorse family, a jumping dolphin, a little submarine, a narwhal under the ice, an otter holding a shell, a sunken treasure chest and a mother whale with her baby.
